ExperimentArtifactRefModel.title: ExperimentArtifactRefModel

ExperimentCaptureSpecReferenceModel.title: ExperimentCaptureSpecReferenceModel

ExperimentClockContextModel.title: ExperimentClockContextModel

ExperimentEpisodeControlModel.description:
Declarative episode execution controls for a planned experiment.

Captures the pre-run execution-control facts — turn order, logical step
count, and episode termination — that ADR-069 requires for CAGE-2
execution-control equivalence but that the archival experiment-core
contracts only record after a run has executed.
ExperimentEpisodeControlModel.title: ExperimentEpisodeControlModel

ExperimentEvidenceSatisfactionReferenceM.description: Evidence concept reference that an artifact claims to satisfy.
ExperimentEvidenceSatisfactionReferenceM.title: ExperimentEvidenceSatisfactionReferenceModel

ExperimentManifestReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to an apparatus or capability manifest.
ExperimentManifestReferenceModel.title: ExperimentManifestReferenceModel

x-aces-invariants.description: Manifest digest qualifiers are limited to processor/backend manifest refs that can be checked against concrete manifest payload digests; manifest path qualifiers are not accepted in v1.

ExperimentParameterModel.description: Redaction-aware parameter captured for a task, run, or apparatus context.
ExperimentParameterModel.title: ExperimentParameterModel

ExperimentProcessorReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to a processor identity.
ExperimentProcessorReferenceModel.title: ExperimentProcessorReferenceModel

ExperimentRedVariantSelectionModel.description: Selection of one red-agent variant bound into a planned experiment.
ExperimentRedVariantSelectionModel.title: ExperimentRedVariantSelectionModel

ExperimentReferenceModel.description: Typed reference to an experiment-core or adjacent ACES artifact.
ExperimentReferenceModel.title: ExperimentReferenceModel

ExperimentRunAllocationPlanModel.description: Structured run allocation, replication, and assignment plan.
ExperimentRunAllocationPlanModel.title: ExperimentRunAllocationPlanModel

x-aces-invariants.description: Run-allocation compared_conditions, condition_assignments keys, embedded condition ids, blocking factor ids, factor-level combinations, and run-level criteria signatures must be internally coherent.

ExperimentRunPlanModel.description:
Pre-run replication, stochastic, episode, and red-variant plan.

Reuses the archival-family value models for stochastic controls, run
allocation, and clock intent, and adds the authoring-only episode and
red-variant selections. Exactly one of ``allocation`` (condition-based)
or ``target_run_count`` (simple, no-condition) declares the run count.
ExperimentRunPlanModel.title: ExperimentRunPlanModel

x-aces-invariants.description: A run plan must declare exactly one of allocation or target_run_count, and every red-variant selection map key must equal its embedded variant_id.

ExperimentScenarioReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to authored scenario material.
ExperimentScenarioReferenceModel.title: ExperimentScenarioReferenceModel

ExperimentStochasticControlModel.description: Seed, randomization, sampling, or scheduler control for reproducibility.
ExperimentStochasticControlModel.title: ExperimentStochasticControlModel

ExperimentStudyFactorModel.description: Treatment, control, blocking, or apparatus factor for study analysis.
ExperimentStudyFactorModel.title: ExperimentStudyFactorModel

ExperimentTaskReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to an experiment task.
ExperimentTaskReferenceModel.title: ExperimentTaskReferenceModel

ExperimentValidityNoteModel.description: Validity threat, limitation, or mitigation note for experiment interpretation.
ExperimentValidityNoteModel.title: ExperimentValidityNoteModel

GovernedEntropyRefModel.description:
Governed reference to sensitive root entropy; never carries raw bytes.

Raw entropy is resolved only at an authorized in-process boundary (out of
scope here) and is never serialized back into this model, a diagnostic, a
fixture, argv, or telemetry (SVR-028).
GovernedEntropyRefModel.title: GovernedEntropyRefModel

PublicSeedModel.description:
Inline public root-entropy seed: fixed-width canonical hex bytes.

Fixed-width lowercase hex removes leading-zero, integer-width, sign, and
Unicode ambiguity from the executable entropy encoding (per the EXP-718
preflight's "Canonical Inputs" section).
PublicSeedModel.title: PublicSeedModel

RandomStreamControlBindingModel.description:
Executable binding: profile identity, namespace, and root entropy.

A seed alone, without generator/derivation/transform identity, is not a
reproducibility claim (SVR-012). ``profile_ref`` is required and
structurally constrained to ``ref_kind="profile"``.
RandomStreamControlBindingModel.title: RandomStreamControlBindingModel

RandomStreamProfileReferenceModel.description: Reference constrained to an accepted random-stream profile.
RandomStreamProfileReferenceModel.title: RandomStreamProfileReferenceModel

description:
Pre-run experiment authoring input: a design that binds a task to a run plan.

This is the authoring/input counterpart to the archival experiment-core
outputs (run/study/apparatus-context). It references the separately
authored task (and optionally a scenario snapshot) and declares the
pre-run experimental design — apparatus intent, run plan, factors,
intended capture, and validity notes — before any run executes. It is
never a run, study, or apparatus-context record (ADR-055 / ADR-074).
title: ExperimentSpecModel

x-aces-invariants.description: When a run plan declares an allocation with blocking factors, every blocking factor must be a declared experiment-spec factor.
